full_judgment: 4. The prosecution case, in short is that on 5.8.2004 at about 7.30 p.m the Informant Khan Muhammad was sitting in the tea-stall of Mofij Uddin at Narayanpur Mouja and at that time one Ishrail along with two unknown persons came to the said tea-stall and sat down. The informant asked them their identity and one of them disclosed that they had hailed from Rajshahi. Their language being quite different from the local language Rajshahi there created a doubt in the mind of Khan Mohammad of (PWI ). At that time Md. Shafiqul Islam, V.D.P. member, was sitting in a nearby tea-stall. The Informant went to Shafiqul Islam (PW5) disclosed to him about the fact and thereafter they both came to the tea-stall of Mofiz Uddin. PW1 caught hold the accused Monir Uddin and Shafiqul Islam (PW5) caught hold the appellant Rafiqul Islam. Khan Muhammad (PW1) made a search to the body of Monir uddin and recovered a 6(six) round bullets load revolver, made in German. Shafiqul Islam (PW5) recovered a sharp bana from the left side of the waist of Rafiqul and recovered five rounds of gun cartridges from the pocket of underwear of Rafiqul. The people attended the said place started assaulting the appellants while Ishrail managed to disappear by running. The matter was informed to S.I. Md. Shamsiil Huq (PW-12). Officer-in-charge. Tanor over cell phone who attended the place of occurrence, prepared a seizure list and took custody of the arms, took the signatures of the witnesses in the seizure list and arrested the appellants and thereafter lodged a FIR.
